name: Impact Ripple
description: Visualizes KPI deviation propagating across 3 dimensions (Driver → Geography → Segment) with animated concentric rings and dominant path highlighting.

kpiLabel.description: Label for the KPI shown in the center node and header (e.g. Gross Margin)

kpiUnit.description: Unit suffix for the KPI value (e.g. % or M)

ring1Label.description: Label for Ring 1 dimension in the legend

ring2Label.description: Label for Ring 2 dimension in the legend

ring3Label.description: Label for Ring 3 dimension in the legend

impactUnit.description: Currency prefix for impact values (e.g. € or $)

pathSummary.description: Optional static override for the path pill text. If empty, auto-generated from data.

feeds.description: 1 measure = KPI + impact. 2nd measure = separate impact.
Order matters: Time → Ring 1 → Ring 2 → Ring 3
